Rasulullaah ﷺ's Words to Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) and Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) when Dispatching them to Yemen

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ sent Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) and Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) to Yemen, he addressed them saying, "Assist each other, work together, tell the people good things and do not make them averse (to the Deen)." When Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) delivered a lecture to the people, he encouraged them towards Islaam, developing a deep understanding of Deen and the Qur'aan. He also said, "I can inform you about those destined for Jannah and those destined for Jahannam. A person is destined for Jannah when people speak good of him and destined for Jahannam when they have no good to speak of him." [^2]
The Statement of Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed (RA) Concerning the Gatherings of the Sahabah (RA) and the Statement of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Concerning the True Aalim

Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) said, "When the Sahabah (RA) of Nabi ﷺ sat together, their discussion always concerned Deen unless one of them was reciting a Surah or having someone else recite a Surah." [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "A man can never occupy a respectable position as a scholar unless he is not jealous of those above him, does not look down on those beneath him and does not seek a price for his knowledge." [^4]
The Statement of Hadhrat Umar (RA) Concerning the Conduct of an Aalim

Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Acquire knowledge and teach the people. Learn also the respectability and composure that goes with it. Humble yourself before those you learn from as well as before those you teach, and never be arrogant Ulema. In this manner, your ignorance will be unable to stand up to your knowledge." [^5]

Ibn Dharees, Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.77), Ibn Asaakir and others, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.231). In his Isti'aab (Vol.2 Pg.44), Ibn Abdul Birr has reported the words from Rasulullaah ﷺ.
